name: Commercial Demand Deposit Account
description: Operating checking account for commercial clients.
client_benefit: Gives the client one operating hub for receipts and disbursements with full account-analysis visibility into every fee.
eligibility_criteria: Revenue tier 10-50M-250M-1B; risk grade Unstable or better; industries: ALL

name: Investment Sweep
description: Overnight sweep of idle operating balances into a money market position.
client_benefit: Puts idle operating cash to work automatically overnight, closing the yield gap without giving up daily liquidity.
eligibility_criteria: Revenue tier 50-250M-250M-1B; risk grade Very Good or better; industries: ALL

name: Positive Pay
description: Check fraud control matching presented checks against an issued-check file.
client_benefit: Stops check fraud before it clears by matching presented items against the client's issue file.
eligibility_criteria: Revenue tier 10-50M-250M-1B; risk grade Unstable or better; industries: ALL

name: Lockbox
description: Bank-operated remittance processing for high-volume check receivables.
client_benefit: Accelerates receivables collection and cuts manual posting by imaging and keying mailed payments.
eligibility_criteria: Revenue tier 50-250M-250M-1B; risk grade Watch or better; industries: 42,45,48
revenue_to_bank: $15k-60k/yr in lockbox item and maintenance fees

name: ACH Origination
description: Electronic origination of ACH credits and debits for payroll and vendor payments.
client_benefit: Moves supplier payments and payroll on the lowest-cost rail with same-day options when timing matters.
eligibility_criteria: Revenue tier 10-50M-250M-1B; risk grade Watch or better; industries: ALL
revenue_to_bank: $5k-20k/yr in ACH transaction and maintenance fees

name: FX Spot Trading
description: Spot purchase and sale of foreign currency for trade settlement.
client_benefit: Converts cross-border receipts and payables at competitive spot rates with same-day settlement.
eligibility_criteria: Revenue tier 50-250M-250M-1B; risk grade Unstable or better; industries: 11,31,32,33,42

name: Commercial Card
description: Corporate purchasing and travel card program with rebate potential.
client_benefit: Extends payables float and earns rebates by shifting supplier spend onto a corporate card program.
eligibility_criteria: Revenue tier 10-50M-250M-1B; risk grade Unstable or better; industries: ALL

name: Revolving Credit Facility
description: Committed line of credit for working-capital needs, drawn and repaid as needed.
client_benefit: Funds seasonal working-capital swings with draw-repay-redraw flexibility priced only on what is used.
eligibility_criteria: Revenue tier 50-250M-250M-1B; risk grade Very Good or better; industries: ALL
revenue_to_bank: $50k-250k/yr in spread and commitment fee income

name: Remote Deposit Capture
description: Desktop or mobile scanning to deposit checks without a branch visit.
client_benefit: Deposits checks from the client's own office the day they arrive, eliminating branch runs.
eligibility_criteria: Revenue tier 10-50M-250M-1B; risk grade Unstable or better; industries: ALL

name: FX Forward Contracts
description: Forward-dated FX contracts to hedge future foreign-currency cash flows.
client_benefit: Locks tomorrow's exchange rate today, protecting margins on committed cross-border flows.
eligibility_criteria: Revenue tier 250M-1B-250M-1B; risk grade Very Good or better; industries: 11,31,32,33,42
revenue_to_bank: $20k-100k/yr in forward points and dealer spread

name: Commercial Letters of Credit
description: Bank-issued payment guarantee supporting import/export trade transactions.
client_benefit: Substitutes the bank's credit for the client's with suppliers, unlocking better terms on imports.
eligibility_criteria: Revenue tier 50-250M-250M-1B; risk grade Very Good or better; industries: 11,31,32,33,42,48

name: Term Loan
description: Amortizing fixed-term loan for capital expenditure or expansion financing.
client_benefit: Finances plant, equipment and expansion with a repayment schedule matched to the asset's life.
eligibility_criteria: Revenue tier 50-250M-250M-1B; risk grade Very Good or better; industries: ALL
revenue_to_bank: $75k-400k/yr in spread income over the loan term

name: Merchant Card Acquiring
description: Card payment acceptance and settlement for businesses collecting customer card payments.
client_benefit: Lets the client accept card payments everywhere they sell, with next-day funding of settlements.
eligibility_criteria: Revenue tier 10-50M-250M-1B; risk grade Watch or better; industries: ALL
revenue_to_bank: $20k-120k/yr in discount rate and per-transaction fees
